title: A renamed rep stays one row under the current name in the report
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} exists; it has a labor line and a part; Labor {Sales-rep-A}, Parts {Sales-rep-B}; it was invoiced today.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: Settings > Staff is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change {Sales-rep-B}'s last name (for example to "Brook") and save.
  2. Open Sales By Representative for today.
  3. Open {Work-order-1}.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the staff record saves.
  • Step 2: the invoice's Parts row is under {Sales-rep-B}'s new name, in one row group (not split into an old-name and a new-name group).
  • Step 3: the invoiced work order still shows the representatives captured when it was invoiced.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S5-R2: “The names captured on the invoice do not change afterwards, including when a staff member is renamed or deactivated. That is what the invoice stores. The report labels each person with their current name, as it does today, so a renamed representative stays one row; it shows the captured name only when the staff record no longer exists.”
  • S5-R1: “When a work order is invoiced, the parts representative and the labor representative in effect are both captured on the invoice, by name.”
